question: Can independently learned continuous causal relationships be selectively repaired and recalled after an intervening environment change while improving unseen recombination decisions over trained conventional controls?
hypothesis: An independently updated three-channel structural causal model with evidence-triggered bounded module repair and preserved prior modules will produce lower held-out goal-action regret than a fully trained recurrent predictor, forgetting-RLS, no-archive, and randomized-repair controls on both returning-A and unfamiliar recombined-C contexts, without exceeding the CPU cap.

predecessor_evidence.note: Historical six-bit causal-memory archive, closed. Not reused or tuned.

inputs.name: procedural continuous 3-state 6-action linear-intervention seed manifest
inputs.source: Self-created deterministic synthetic equations, generated only by pinned experiment code; no real-world/private data.

frozen_design.split: Sixteen disjoint first-use evaluation worlds; each world has ordered A->B->A->C regimes, where B changes one causal row and unfamiliar C composes one A row, one B row, and one novel row. Never reuse SL15 physical worlds. Separate deterministic evaluator-only probe RNG.
frozen_design.ordering: Exactly 72 A, 72 B, 24 return-A, 24 unseen-recombined-C paid intervention observations per world per arm. Same initial states, motor interventions, and resulting observations supplied to every arm. Evaluate after 72,144,168,192 with exactly 12 fresh action-consequence goal probes/arm/checkpoint. Three cold snapshots after observations 71,143,167.
frozen_design.data_budget: 16 worlds x 5 arms x 192 causal observations = 15360 paid training steps, plus 16 x 5 x 4 x 12 = 3840 actual audit action steps; total 19200 independently charged steps, no held-out audit feedback to learner.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Pure Python 3.12 stdlib CPU on Ubuntu and Windows, one original 16-world prospective first-use per OS. No GPU, remote models or paid APIs; 10 feature causal rows, max three 3x10 RLS models per channel, conventional 8-hidden-unit trainable RNN (all weights updated), and 10-feature forgetting RLS.
frozen_design.capacity: Candidate at most 3 archived RLS modules per output, 3 outputs, 10 input dimensions; negative randomized switch identical budget; no-archive at most one active RLS model per output. All learners start without learned weights or world labels.
frozen_design.evaluator: At each audit, 12 unseen state/target pairs, 6 action counterfactuals evaluator-only; each model selects one action then physically observes its own action consequence for regret scoring, without training. Primary regret = mean (squared distance of actual next state to target minus minimum six-action squared distance). Score one-step prediction MSE. True A/B/C row lineage used only in evaluator's offline structural attribution.
frozen_design.training_policy: Identical fixed charged six-action cycling with deterministic exogenous state reseeds every eighth step; each state reset is visibly accounted in ledger; no selection of extra training actions.
frozen_design.note: Synthetically compositional native-research proposal, not native Yggdrasil architecture integration, language understanding, or AGI evidence.

controls.name: no_archive
controls.description: Same causal model and observations, at most one module per channel; detected contradictions repair in place.

controls.name: random_repair
controls.description: Same three-module storage, event gate, and exposures as candidate, but chooses non-active archived module via deterministic random choice instead of residual evidence.

controls.name: forgetting_rls
controls.description: Independent decayed recursive least squares, all ten features and all 192 observations per output, one shared model.

controls.name: trained_recurrent
controls.description: Conventional 8-hidden-unit recurrent state predictor: all recurrent, input, output, and bias weights optimized online on the same 192 transitions, without freezing hidden layers.

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY if ALL frozen gates: returned-A candidate mean regret <= min(forgetting_rls,trained_recurrent)-0.01; unfamiliar C candidate mean regret <= min(forgetting_rls,trained_recurrent)-0.01; both <= respective no_archive and random_repair -0.01; returned-A and C selected-action prediction MSE no greater than independent forgetting_rls; genuine offline A recall in >=8/16 worlds and correct C composition in >=8/16 worlds; 100% cold parity, <=65536 bytes, exact total 19200 paid steps, no evaluator leakage; median learner-update-and-selection CPU ratio <=2.5x forgetting_rls and <=2.0x no_archive on EACH OS. Engineering PASS does not establish science acceptance.
classification_rules.mixed: MIXED_DEV if valid experiment fails one or more primary gates but has positive return-A or C regret advantage over at least one registered same-information control or genuine reuse in at least one world.
classification_rules.negative: NEGATIVE_DEV if valid experiment fails primary gates and has no qualifying partial evidence; preserve all failures without retuning.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE if source/protocol/seed identity, exact steps, frozen controls, deterministic cross-OS non-timing parity, zero evaluator leakage, snapshot parity, or physical custody fails. Never convert an unfavorable valid outcome into infrastructure failure.

prohibited_after_primary_run: using primary outcome to retune CR16
promoting a synthetic development result to native scientific acceptance
